items.title: Can you train AI to invert AES?
items.raw_excerpt: At the core of every https browser session, every wifi connection with WPA2/3, every hardware level device encryption module, sits the AES algorithm. This makes inverting the algorithm - the process of finding the private key or the clear text - one of the most simultaneously dangerous and valuable algorithmic problems today.
